name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central Sector scheme providing income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.

benefit.description: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account in 3 installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.

general: Farmer family must hold cultivable land in their name
Must complete e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal
Bank account must be linked and mapped with Aadhaar & NPCI
otherConditions: Institutional landholders and serving/retired government officers are excluded
Income tax payers from last assessment year are excluded

eligibilityChecks.question: Do you or your family own cultivable agricultural land registered in your name?
Have you completed or are you willing to complete OTP/Biometric e-KYC?
Did you pay income tax in the last financial assessment year?

requiredDocuments: Land Ownership Documents (Khata / Pattadar Passbook / RoR)
applicationProcess: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit nearest CSC / MeeSeva center
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' in the Farmers Corner
Enter Aadhaar Number, Select State, and Verify via OTP
Fill land record details (Survey number, Khasra, Khata number, Area in Hectares)
Upload land documents and submit for state revenue department verification
Track status online using Aadhaar or Registration Number

applicationWindow.details: Continuous online registration available on portal

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
aiContext: Provides ₹6,000/year in 3 installments of ₹2,000 for landholder farmers. Requires land ownership records, Aadhaar e-KYC, and active bank account. Income tax payers excluded.

faqs.question: Can tenant farmers apply for PM-KISAN?
faqs.answer: No, PM-KISAN requires ownership of cultivable land records in the applicant's or family's name.

faqs.question: How often are the installments paid?
faqs.answer: Every 4 months: April-July, August-November, and December-March.

faqs.question: Is e-KYC mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, e-KYC via OTP on PM-KISAN portal or biometric at CSC is mandatory.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support and risk cover to farmers against crop failure due to non-preventable natural risks.

benefit.amount: Full Sum Insured based on crop yield loss
benefit.description: Subsidized premium (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops). Comprehensive coverage from pre-sowing to post-harvest losses.

general: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas during the season
Includes sharecroppers and tenant farmers with insurable interest
Both loanee and non-loanee farmers are eligible
otherConditions: Must apply before the seasonal cut-off date announced by state government

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you cultivating a notified crop in a designated insured area?
Do you hold land ownership or recorded tenancy agreement for the cultivated crop?

requiredDocuments: Land Record Documents (RoR / Sowing Certificate from Patwari/VRO)
Tenancy / Crop Share Declaration (for tenant farmers)
applicationProcess: Visit PMFBY Portal (pmfby.gov.in), nearest CSC, or your designated bank branch
Enter farmer details, crop sown, area in acres/hectares, and land survey number
Pay nominal farmer premium share online or at bank
Download Policy Receipt with coverage details

applicationWindow.details: Kharif window closes around July 31; Rabi window closes around December 31

dependsOn: Crop Cutting Experiments (CCE) yield loss data

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
aiContext: Covers crop damage from drought, floods, pests. Premium is 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% horticultural. Open to both loanee and non-loanee farmers.

faqs.question: Is PMFBY mandatory for KCC loan holders?
faqs.answer: No, PMFBY has been made completely voluntary for all farmers, including loan holders.

faqs.question: How do I report localized crop damage like hailstorm?
faqs.answer: Report via the Crop Insurance Mobile App or to your bank within 72 hours of the event.

name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
description: Provides adequate and timely credit support from the banking system to farmers for cultivation and other agricultural needs with interest subvention.

benefit.description: Short-term credit up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of only 4% per annum (with 3% prompt repayment incentive). Collateral-free up to ₹1.60 Lakh.

general: Individual farmers / Joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
SHGs or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers
otherConditions: Applicants above 60 years need a co-applicant who is a legal heir

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you engaged in crop cultivation, dairy, poultry, or fisheries?
Do you have a clean credit record without willful defaults?

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Driving License
Land Record Documents (Pattadar passbook / 7/12 extract / RoR)
Cropping pattern proof from local agriculture officer
applicationProcess: Download standard 1-page KCC Application Form from banking/ministry portal
Fill personal details, land particulars, and crop details
Submit form with land documents to your nearest Commercial, Cooperative, or Regional Rural Bank (RRB)
Bank processes KCC limit within 14 days and issues RuPay Kisan Credit Card

applicationWindow.details: Applications accepted throughout the year at bank branches

dependsOn: Bank credit appraisal and land verification

modeOfApplication: Online Portal (PSB Loans in 59 Minutes / Bank Apps)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
aiContext: Provides up to ₹3 lakh crop loan at 4% effective interest upon timely repayment. Collateral-free up to ₹1.60 lakh. Also covers animal husbandry and fisheries.

faqs.question: Can dairy and fish farmers get KCC?
faqs.answer: Yes, KCC limit of up to ₹2 Lakh is available specifically for animal husbandry, dairy, and fisheries.

faqs.question: Is collateral required for KCC?
faqs.answer: No collateral is required for loans up to ₹1.60 Lakh (or ₹3 Lakh under tie-up arrangements).

name: Annadata Sukhibhava / Rythu Bharosa - PM KISAN
description: Andhra Pradesh government scheme providing financial assistance to farmer families (combining PM-KISAN and state farmer support).

benefit.description: Financial assistance per year distributed in installments across Kharif, Rabi, and Sankranti seasons.

general: Must be a resident farmer of Andhra Pradesh
Must hold agricultural land or be a certified tenant farmer (CCRC holder)
SC, ST, BC, and Minority tenant farmers are eligible even without land ownership
otherConditions: Must not be an institutional landholder or high-ranking public official

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you a permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh?
Do you have 1B land record or a valid Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC)?

requiredDocuments: Pattadar Passbook / 1B Document or CCRC Agreement (Tenant farmers)
applicationProcess: Contact your Village Agriculture Assistant (VAA) at the Village Secretariat (Grama Sachivalayam)
Submit land records / CCRC tenant registration for e-Crop booking
Verify name in the beneficiary and social audit list displayed at the Grama Sachivalayam
Funds credited directly via DBT to Aadhaar-enabled bank accounts

applicationWindow.details: Enrolment verified prior to seasonal disbursement

ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
aiContext: Andhra Pradesh state scheme providing financial assistance to landholder and SC/ST/BC/Minority tenant farmers with CCRC cards. Accessible at annadathasukhibhava.ap.gov.in.

faqs.question: Are tenant farmers eligible in AP?
faqs.answer: Yes, SC, ST, BC, and Minority tenant farmers with valid CCRC (Crop Cultivator Rights Card) receive full ₹13,500 directly from state funds.

faqs.question: Where should I submit the application?
faqs.answer: At your local Grama Sachivalayam (Village Secretariat) or Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK).
